uncharacterizedClaims: successful inline-optimize AI completion on REFERENCE-CPU-01
policy: The first release may claim support only for the exact observed REFERENCE-CPU-01 runtime fingerprint that produced repeated passing characterization receipts. It may not infer support for weaker or merely similar hardware. Canonical trusted-core flows must complete within 90 seconds. Container-cold startup with retained volumes must reach READY within 45 seconds. Inline Optimize is optional and must return either a fact-preserving AI result or its deterministic safe fallback within 20 seconds; AI completion itself is not a release requirement on this profile.
